vacancy.title: Satcom Systems and Payload Lead
vacancy.assessment: Direct ESA A2-A4 ESTEC role combining multidisciplinary technical leadership, industrial prime interfaces, payload qualification, verification, schedule/cost control. Strong leadership ambitions but requires specific advanced digital telecom payload and SatCom mission expertise, so a substantial specialist stretch. Minimum MSc plus 4 years relevant experience; A1 possible if post-MSc experience limited.
